failed.explain: The node errored (the agent or its provider failed).
failed.label: Failed

interrupted.explain: The node was still running when the run stopped (force stop, crash or lost runtime).
interrupted.label: Interrupted

rejected.explain: The verifier rejected the work and gave feedback.
rejected.label: Rejected

running.explain: The agent is working right now.
running.label: Running

succeeded.explain: The node finished and returned a result.
succeeded.label: Succeeded

voided.explain: Zeroshot discarded this execution (for example after a restart).
voided.label: Voided
